explication: This repository is the WSO2 API Manager documentation site. The principal workflow is: contributors edit Markdown under `en/docs`, MkDocs loads those sources and invokes `en/hooks.py`, then renders a browsable site for API Manager users. The documentation spans API design, developer consumption, gateway operation, AI gateway features, security, and administration. The tree does not include the MkDocs configuration or referenced external YAML/JSON inputs, so those wiring details are omitted.
